config.goal: 64 official dates: daily return MAE < 0.01 percentage points
config.metric: mean absolute difference of unrounded model daily percentage change and the official displayed percentage

findings: All 64 dates had already participated in research; the two halves only guard against one lucky regime.
The seed window of the robust initialization was widened from 20 to 32 sessions. Every window from 24 to 44 passes the round-1 guard, so the choice is a plateau, not a knife edge.
decay=0.9230 reaches a lower full-window MAE (0.011231) but raises the second-half MAE and the level-ratio coefficient of variation, so the guard rejects it.
The residual is concentrated: 2026-08-03, 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-23 carry 36 percent of the absolute error, and the remaining 61 days already average 0.007183 pp.

The app's own intraday bar, read from the archived screenshots, matches the model's overnight and intraday legs within 0.05 to 0.28 pp on six of seven sampled sessions; on 2026-08-31 the model's 09:30 value lies 512.7 bn CNY below the app's own intraday low, so the app bar and the model cannot both describe that session.

Amount-based turnover, free-float turnover, dropping suspended names, lagged float, adjusted prices, survival=off, per-stock decay, turnover floors, f caps and damped turnover surprises were all measured and rejected.
The strict target is still missed by 0.001279 pp.
